messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY ALERT - HIGH: Observability ingest error spike for priv-vpc-observe (multiple ILB frontends). Triggered at 2026-03-15T02:31:30Z. Pager: oncall-eng
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2234567890 - Observability ingest failures (priv-vpc). Paging oncall. Linking runbook: https://redwood/intern/runbooks/obs-ingest-privvpc
anika: oncall here, investigating. I saw alerts for 502/504 from gcp-ilb to observability-ingest backends. Confirming scope: are customer-facing requests affected or only internal metrics pipeline?
derek: I can join, grabbing logs. Seeing increased 503s from ilb->obs-ingest-proxy with auth token errors: "401: tokenfetch failed: 429 from metadata". Looks like metadata service throttling when obs agents try to refresh tokens.
rupert: Confirmed from packet captures — a subset of private VPC hosts in us-central1 are failing to reach metadata server consistently, responses time out then ILB returns 502. This matches spike window.
anika: thanks. Quick mitigation: can we pause telemetry export from private VPC agents to reduce token churn? That should drop metadata calls and ease the metadata API.
helena: CS flagged customers seeing increased latency for dashboards (10–20% of dashboard loads erroring). CS thread: "several enterprise customers in EU reporting missing traces". Tagging cs-rep.
cs-rep: yep, customers asking. We need an incident status update to customers ASAP. Minimal details ok — we're investigating a third-party metadata/auth degradation affecting observability for private VPCs. ETA for update?
anika: I can post short status in 10m. Mitigation first. Derek/rupert, steps to throttle agent traffic?
derek: We can disable agent upload via org-level feature flag for private VPCs. Command (run on config service):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://config.redwood/api/v1/flags/obs-agent-upload:disable -d '{"scope":"private-vpc"}'
```
Will reduce outgoing requests immediately (agents poll config every 30s). Pushing now.
ops-bot: exec finished: flag update propagated to 842 hosts in 34s.
rupert: I'm seeing a drop in metadata calls already (~60% reduction). ILB 502s are dropping but still some residuals from retries.
anika: good. Can we also temporarily route observability egress through fallback NAT in us-west1 for affected privatevpc region? That will avoid the troubled metadata path and spread load.
derek: We can add BGP route override, but that needs infra approval. I'll coordinate with network. In the meantime, increasing obs-ingest replicas in us-central1 to absorb queued requests. kubectl scale deployment obs-ingest-proxy --replicas=8 -n observability
rupert: Scale accepted, replicas going up. Watching for 5xx rate.
helena: CS: please include note that we're throttling telemetry (no data loss expected for customers, data will be buffered and re-ingested) — customers want reassurance.
anika: Drafting update: "We're investigating an observability ingestion disruption affecting Private VPC dashboards. We've throttled agent uploads and scaled ingestion backends to mitigate. We're working with GCP networking teams on fallback routing. No confirmed data loss; some recent telemetry may be delayed. We'll update in 30 minutes." Approve? :white_check_mark:
cs-rep: Approved. Post it.
ops-bot: Status update posted to customers: "Investigating observability ingestion disruption for Private VPCs; mitigation in progress. Next update in 30m."
dan: (system) note: automated alerting reduced by 80% after flag.
rupert: ILB 502 rate now down to baseline + small tail. Metadata 429s cut by 70%. Still seeing sporadic auth token refresh failures for hosts with older agent versions.
derek: Action: create hotfix job to roll agents that use newer token caching (v2.1.4). I triggered canary rollout to 50 hosts. Command:
```
./deploy-agent --group=priv-vpc-canary --version=v2.1.4
```
Watching canary now.
anika: Nice. For oncall handoff: I need to be offline in ~25m. I'll summarize and hand to Derek. Derek, be prepared to escalate to network if routing fallback still needed.
derek: acknowledged. I'm on-call backup and will take over at 03:00 UTC if still active.
rupert: Ops note for postmortem: root likely GCP metadata API rate limits combined with agents with aggressive short-lived token refresh. Remediation: agent backoff, better token caching, and a config flag to batch metadata requests.
anika: Handoff summary for Derek (copy into incident timeline):
- What happened: Metadata/token refresh rate limiting in GCP for a subset of Private VPC hosts caused ILB 502/503 to obs-ingest backends.
- Impact: Observability ingestion degraded for private-vpc customers in us-central1 (dashboard errors, delayed traces). CS notified.
- Actions taken: throttled agent uploads for private-vpc, scaled obs-ingest replicas, canary agent rollout (v2.1.4), drafting customer comms, coordinating network for fallback routing if residuals persist.
- Current status: errors reduced, monitoring for reappears. CS update posted.
derek: Got it. I'll continue monitoring logs, complete canary, and open a net ticket with GCP if token 429s persist after full rollout. I'll add triage items to INC-2234567890.
anika: assigning next steps in the incident doc and closing loop with CS once stable. Leaving notes for postmortem. :memo:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2234567890 status -> mitigated (partial). Assign: derek.
derek: taking over. If anything spikes I'll page network and escalate to engineering lead. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
